verdict.rationale: Shopify's POS features page documents Sidekick, Shopify's built-in AI assistant. It gives reordering suggestions based on sales velocity and seasonality, and it can recommend stock transfers between locations and create them for you automatically, which is genuine task delegation. The documented scope is narrow (inventory tasks only), and it is unclear whether Sidekick runs inside the POS app itself or in the Shopify admin. Missing for 10: evidence of delegation beyond inventory and stock-transfer tasks, in-depth first-party docs on Sidekick's capabilities and limits inside POS, independent or hands-on corroboration.
